cards.title: Power Down
cards.body:
Your battery is at 5%.
This is not a failure, it is protection.
Let the screen go dark for a bit.
cards.footer: The world will not fall apart if you rest for ten minutes.

cards.title: Gravity Hug
cards.body:
Feel the mattress supporting your body.
You are the one being held.
cards.footer: Right now, you are safe.

cards.title: Look at Your Palm
cards.body:
Raise your hand and look at the lines.
No need to find meaning, just confirm you are here.
cards.footer: Existing is a win.

cards.title: Empty Room
cards.body:
Imagine yourself as an empty room.
Emotions come and go, but you stay.
cards.footer: You are the backdrop, not the scene.

cards.title: Pause Button
cards.body:
Press pause. The frame freezes.
Go drink some water and come back.
cards.footer: The story will wait for you, or it will not, and that is okay.

cards.title: Invisibility Cloak
cards.body:
Do Not Disturb, no replies to emails.
You are temporarily logged out.
cards.footer: If they cannot find you, that is on them.

cards.title: Silent Mode
cards.body: Close your eyes and turn nearby sounds into white noise.
cards.footer: In this dimension, no one can reach you.

cards.title: Trash It
cards.body:
Bundle the thoughts in your head and throw them out.
Thunk, lid closed.
cards.footer: Clear the cache, no recycling required.

cards.title: Low Battery
cards.body:
Turn today's output to minimum.
Allow yourself to stay where you are.
cards.footer: Pausing is not failure.

cards.title: Soft Landing
cards.body:
Sit down, feet on the floor.
Hand your weight to the ground.
cards.footer: Being supported is also progress.

cards.title: Ten Minutes
cards.body:
Give yourself ten minutes with no decisions.
Just breathe.
cards.footer: A small rest still recharges.

cards.title: Blanket Weight
cards.body:
Put a blanket over you.
Feel the safety of being wrapped.
cards.footer: You do not have to hold it all.

cards.title: One Thing
cards.body:
Do just one small thing today.
Done is a win.
cards.footer: Low goals give you room.

cards.title: Borrowed Support
cards.body:
Put the phone down and lean on the chair.
Let it hold you for a while.
cards.footer: You do not have to carry it all.

cards.title: Half Speed
cards.body:
Move at half speed.
You are not in a race.
cards.footer: Slow is still forward.

cards.title: Power Button
cards.body:
Pretend you have a power button.
Press it and let the system sleep.
cards.footer: Sleep is not shutdown.

cards.title: No Fight
cards.body:
Do not fight the tiredness today.
It is just asking you to pause.
cards.footer: Hearing it is enough.

cards.title: By the Window
cards.body:
Look at the light outside for a moment.
No meaning required.
cards.footer: Light will come in on its own.

cards.title: Power Saver
cards.body:
Set social, work, and feelings to power saver.
Keep only what is necessary.
cards.footer: Saving energy is smart.

cards.title: Light Task
cards.body:
Pick the lightest task.
Finish it, then stop.
cards.footer: Stopping is part of finishing.

cards.title: Drink Water
cards.body:
Drink a glass of water, then decide the next step.
No rush right now.
cards.footer: Refuel before you move.

cards.title: Slow Breaths
cards.body:
Inhale for four counts, exhale for four.
Let the rhythm carry you.
cards.footer: Breath is a free charger.

cards.title: No Hero
cards.body:
No need to be a hero today.
Just hold on in an ordinary way.
cards.footer: Ordinary is worthy.

cards.title: Micro Rest
cards.body:
Close your eyes for 30 seconds.
This is allowed.
cards.footer: Tiny rests add up.

cards.title: Loose Grip
cards.body:
Relax your shoulders.
Imagine loosening what you are holding.
cards.footer: You do not have to grip so tight.

cards.title: Head Down
cards.body:
Rest your forehead on the desk for ten seconds.
Let your head rest too.
cards.footer: A short pause is okay.

cards.title: Delay Allowed
cards.body:
Allow yourself to push things back a little today.
That does not make you bad.
cards.footer: Delaying a bit still keeps you alive.

cards.title: Minimum Version
cards.body:
Do the minimum version today.
Done is enough.
cards.footer: Low power still runs.

cards.title: No Catching Up
cards.body:
The world runs fast.
You do not have to chase.
cards.footer: Your pace still counts.

cards.title: Lean
cards.body:
Find a backrest and lean for a while.
Let your body loosen.
cards.footer: Leaning still lets you continue.

cards.title: Shrink the List
cards.body:
Cut the list down to three items.
Everything else is for tomorrow.
cards.footer: Smaller is safer.

cards.title: Pause Screen
cards.body:
Imagine the screen is frozen.
You can step away.
cards.footer: Pause is not the end.

cards.title: Light Social
cards.body:
Say fewer words today.
Power saver is still kind.
cards.footer: Quiet is not cold.

cards.title: Warmth
cards.body:
Place your palms on a warm cup.
Notice the temperature.
cards.footer: Warmth brings you back.

cards.title: Lie Down
cards.body:
If you can, lie down for a bit.
No explanation needed.
cards.footer: Rest has meaning.

cards.title: Later Sprint
cards.body:
No sprint today.
Wait for your battery to return.
cards.footer: Later is still in time.

cards.title: Name Five Things
cards.body:
Find five things you can see.
Say their names out loud.
cards.footer: Sound brings you back.

cards.title: Cold Water
cards.body:
Run cold water over your wrists.
Feel the shock.
cards.footer: A spark can wake you.

cards.title: Finger Taps
cards.body:
Tap the desk with your fingertips.
Listen to the rhythm.
cards.footer: Rhythm is here.

cards.title: Wall Texture
cards.body:
Touch a wall surface.
Rough or smooth is fine.
cards.footer: Texture is real.

cards.title: Count the Tiles
cards.body:
Count floor tiles or window panes.
Ten is enough.
cards.footer: Numbers help you land.

cards.title: Hand on Chest
cards.body:
Place a hand on your chest.
Feel the rise and fall.
cards.footer: You are still here.

cards.title: Press the Floor
cards.body:
Press your heels into the floor for three seconds.
Then release.
cards.footer: The ground stays.

cards.title: Soft Focus
cards.body:
Soften your gaze until it blurs.
See the whole instead of details.
cards.footer: Blur is okay.

cards.title: Slow Blinks
cards.body:
Blink slowly five times.
Like a tiny reboot.
cards.footer: Restart a little.

cards.title: Three Sounds
cards.body:
Find three different sounds.
Far, near, and inside you.
cards.footer: Sound locates you.

cards.title: Light and Shadow
cards.body:
Find the edge between light and shadow.
Watch it for a moment.
cards.footer: Edges wake you.

cards.title: Count Breaths
cards.body:
Count from one to eight with your breath.
If you lose track, it is fine.
cards.footer: Any count counts.

cards.title: Small Movement
cards.body:
Roll your shoulders twice.
Give the body a bit of presence.
cards.footer: A little is enough.

cards.title: Squeeze and Release
cards.body:
Clench your fist for three seconds.
Then release slowly.
cards.footer: Releasing is a motion.

cards.title: Warm Food
cards.body:
Imagine the warmth of soup.
If you can, take a sip.
cards.footer: Warmth pulls you back.

cards.title: A Color
cards.body:
Find a color you like.
Use it as an anchor.
cards.footer: Color can be a rope.

cards.title: Stretch Fingers
cards.body:
Open and close your fingers.
Repeat five times.
cards.footer: Small repeats settle you.

cards.title: Trace the Edge
cards.body:
Trace the edge of the table with a finger.
Go slowly.
cards.footer: Edges make you clear.

cards.title: Scent Check
cards.body:
Smell your shirt or pillow.
One second is enough.
cards.footer: Smell is honest.

cards.title: Shift Weight
cards.body:
Shift your weight from left to right.
Three times is enough.
cards.footer: Movement is existence.

cards.title: Step in Place
cards.body:
Step in place ten times.
Feel the soles.
cards.footer: Steps remind you.

cards.title: Short Walk
cards.body:
Walk to the door and back.
A small loop counts.
cards.footer: The path does not need to be long.

cards.title: Shake Hands
cards.body:
Shake your hands for ten seconds.
Loosen the numbness.
cards.footer: Let blood move.

cards.title: Touch Fabric
cards.body:
Touch the edge of your clothes or blanket.
Feel the fibers.
cards.footer: Details pull you back.

cards.title: Check Temperature
cards.body:
Notice if the air is cool or warm.
Say it out loud.
cards.footer: Naming makes it real.

cards.title: Look Up
cards.body:
Look up at the ceiling or the sky.
Pick a corner.
cards.footer: Looking up changes the channel.

cards.title: One Word
cards.body:
Give this moment one word.
Simple is enough.
cards.footer: A word is an anchor.

cards.title: Tap the Knees
cards.body:
Tap your knees left and right.
Like soothing yourself.
cards.footer: You can be soothed.

cards.title: Do Not Disturb
cards.body:
Set your phone to Do Not Disturb.
You are offline today.
cards.footer: Temporary disappearance is allowed.

cards.title: Small Cave
cards.body:
Find a small corner to sit.
Smaller can feel safer.
cards.footer: Small spaces protect.

cards.title: Close the Door
cards.body:
Close a door.
Let the outside stay outside.
cards.footer: The door is your boundary.

cards.title: Reply Later
cards.body:
Delay the replies.
Not replying is a choice.
cards.footer: You have the right not to respond.

cards.title: Cover the Screen
cards.body:
Turn the screen face down or cover it.
Let your eyes rest.
cards.footer: Not seeing is okay.

cards.title: Safe Corner
cards.body:
Pick a place that feels safe.
Stay there for a bit.
cards.footer: Safety can be a place.

cards.title: Invisible Mode
cards.body:
Imagine putting on an invisibility cloak.
No one can find you.
cards.footer: You do not have to show up today.

cards.title: Mute Notifications
cards.body:
Mute notifications for an hour.
The world will not collapse.
cards.footer: You are not customer service.

cards.title: Hide for a While
cards.body:
Tell yourself: only for a while.
Not forever.
cards.footer: Short is enough.

cards.title: No Explanation
cards.body:
You do not need to explain today.
Silence is valid.
cards.footer: You do not owe a manual.

cards.title: One Step Back
cards.body:
Step back a little.
Give yourself buffer.
cards.footer: Distance is safety.

cards.title: Quiet Bubble
cards.body:
Imagine a clear bubble around you.
The outside cannot reach.
cards.footer: It is quiet inside.

cards.title: Dim the Lights
cards.body:
Dim the lights a bit.
Lower brightness, lower pressure.
cards.footer: Even light can be power saver.

cards.title: Offline Mode
cards.body:
Set yourself to offline.
Come back later.
cards.footer: Offline is not gone.

cards.title: Shrink Social
cards.body:
Today, face only one person or one task.
Everything else can fade.
cards.footer: Smaller lets you breathe.

cards.title: Pause Chats
cards.body:
Put chat windows aside.
No need to reply now.
cards.footer: Later is fine.

cards.title: Close One Tab
cards.body:
Close one webpage or app.
One less doorway.
cards.footer: Fewer doors, calmer mind.

cards.title: Off Stage
cards.body:
You can step off stage for a while.
The show goes on.
cards.footer: Stepping out is rhythm.

cards.title: Small Room
cards.body:
Imagine a small room just for you.
The door says Do Not Disturb.
cards.footer: It is yours.

cards.title: Leave It Unopened
cards.body:
Do not open the message yet.
Not looking will not break it.
cards.footer: Handle it later.

cards.title: Short Disconnect
cards.body:
Allow a short disconnect.
A day is okay.
cards.footer: Disconnect is not wrong.

cards.title: Back in the Shell
cards.body:
Like a small animal, go back into your shell.
Stay quiet.
cards.footer: The shell protects you.

cards.title: Avoid the Crowd
cards.body:
Avoid the crowd today.
Take the small path.
cards.footer: Small paths still lead out.

cards.title: Only Breathe
cards.body:
Just breathe today.
Everything else can wait.
cards.footer: Breathing is the task.

cards.title: Silent Phone
cards.body:
Put your phone on silent.
The world will not fall.
cards.footer: A little quiet helps.

cards.title: Rain Check
cards.body:
Give yourself an excuse, like it is raining.
Staying in is reasonable.
cards.footer: An excuse can be protection.

cards.title: Narrow the View
cards.body:
See only one meter ahead.
Do not look farther.
cards.footer: One meter is enough.

cards.title: Return Slowly
cards.body:
You can return slowly.
No need to show up right away.
cards.footer: Coming back can be slow.

cards.title: Noise Cancel
cards.body:
Cover your ears with headphones or your palms.
Give noise a mute button.
cards.footer: You can turn the volume down.

cards.title: Long Exhale
cards.body:
Exhale long and slow.
Let the heat out.
cards.footer: Exhale is release.

cards.title: Jaw Release
cards.body:
Relax a clenched jaw.
Let your teeth separate.
cards.footer: A little release is enough.

cards.title: Drop the Shoulders
cards.body:
Drop your shoulders down.
Like taking off a bag.
cards.footer: Less weight is lighter.

cards.title: Write It Down
cards.body:
Write the irritation on paper.
Close it when done.
cards.footer: Paper can hold it.

cards.title: Trash Bin
cards.body:
Imagine the noise as trash.
Throw it in the bin.
cards.footer: Throwing away is handling.

cards.title: Name It
cards.body:
Give the irritation a name.
Like "buzz".
cards.footer: Names make it smaller.

cards.title: One Meter Boundary
cards.body:
Set a one meter safety circle.
No one enters.
cards.footer: Boundaries are yours.

cards.title: Lower the Volume
cards.body:
Imagine a volume knob on the world.
Turn it down.
cards.footer: You have the knob.

cards.title: Cold Splash
cards.body:
Splash cold water on your face.
Lower the heat.
cards.footer: Cold breaks the loop.

cards.title: Unclench Hands
cards.body:
Open and close your fingers.
Let tension out.
cards.footer: A little release helps.

cards.title: Count to Ten
cards.body:
Count slowly to ten.
Every number counts.
cards.footer: Numbers are a brake.

cards.title: Shake It Out
cards.body:
Stand and shake your arms and legs.
Scatter the heat.
cards.footer: Movement clears.

cards.title: Move Fast
cards.body:
Walk fast for one minute.
Give the irritation an exit.
cards.footer: Sweat is an exit.

cards.title: Vent Three Lines
cards.body:
Let yourself vent three lines.
Then stop.
cards.footer: Short venting releases pressure.

cards.title: Stop Inputs
cards.body:
No scrolling, no watching, no listening for a bit.
Stop new inputs.
cards.footer: Less input is relief.

cards.title: Turn Away
cards.body:
Turn your body toward a wall or window.
Change direction.
cards.footer: Direction is a choice.

cards.title: Longer Exhale
cards.body:
Make your exhale longer than inhale.
Carry the heat out.
cards.footer: Long exhale calms.

cards.title: Close Tabs
cards.body:
Close a few tabs in your mind.
Leave only one.
cards.footer: Fewer is quieter.

cards.title: Crumple It
cards.body:
Write the irritation and crumple it.
Throw it away.
cards.footer: Throwing away releases.

cards.title: Phone Face Down
cards.body:
Place your phone face down.
Let it be quiet.
cards.footer: A little silence helps.

cards.title: Three Rounds
cards.body:
Inhale for four, exhale for six.
Repeat three times.
cards.footer: Rhythm cools.

cards.title: Slow Chew
cards.body:
If you are eating, chew slowly.
Focus on texture.
cards.footer: Texture brings you back.

cards.title: Step Outside
cards.body:
Step out of the room for a minute.
Change the air.
cards.footer: New air changes mood.

cards.title: One Honest Line
cards.body:
Write one honest sentence.
It does not need to be pretty.
cards.footer: Truth loosens knots.

cards.title: Drop the Bag
cards.body:
If you carry a bag, put it down.
Let your shoulders be empty.
cards.footer: Empty feels lighter.

cards.title: Hold a Cup
cards.body:
Hold a cup and feel its weight.
Let the weight ground you.
cards.footer: Weight can calm.

cards.title: Keep One Breath
cards.body:
Tell yourself: keep one breath.
Everything else can wait.
cards.footer: One breath is enough.

cards.title: Low Battery Moment
cards.body:
You are not lazy right now, your battery is empty.
Drink some water, then decide whether to continue.
cards.footer: Keeping some battery is a victory for today.

cards.title: Slow Plan
cards.body:
Your body is telling you: no sprinting yet.
Slow the pace first, complicated things can wait.
cards.footer: Let your heartbeat come back to normal speed first.

cards.title: Pause Version
cards.body:
Today you are built for low-power mode.
Do the lightest thing first, then stop.
cards.footer: Pausing is part of moving forward.

cards.title: Power-Saving Mode
cards.body:
Tiredness is not failure, it is a warning light.
Close your eyes for ten breaths, no decisions yet.
cards.footer: Steady yourself first, and things will steady too.

cards.title: Bare-Minimum Button
cards.body:
Your system needs to cool down first.
Put the phone down and give your brain some quiet.
cards.footer: You have tried hard enough, ease off for now.

cards.title: Short-Rest Protocol
cards.body:
This is not stalling, it is necessary maintenance.
Sit down for two minutes and let your body land.
cards.footer: You can be slow without blaming yourself.

cards.title: Light-Load Reminder
cards.body:
You have held on long enough, you can set it down.
Let your shoulders drop, stop bracing.
cards.footer: Rest is a skill, not an excuse.

cards.title: Endurance Lane
cards.body:
Admit you are tired first, then decide the next step.
Just get through today, no need to overachieve.
cards.footer: A small recovery still counts as recovery.

cards.title: Buffer First
cards.body:
You do not need to be productive every minute.
Cut the list in half, keep only the smallest task.
cards.footer: Do not overdraw today, so tomorrow has room.

cards.title: Lightweight Route
cards.body:
Right now the priority is saving what battery is left.
Let yourself rest first, then come back.
cards.footer: Going slower does not make you a failure.

cards.title: Downshift Moment
cards.body:
Do not pick a fight with a low battery.
Slow your movements a little, tend to your breathing first.
cards.footer: Put yourself first today.

cards.title: Quiet Plan
cards.body:
The bar can sit lower today.
Finish one small thing, put the rest on hold.
cards.footer: Keeping some battery is a victory for today.

cards.title: Low Battery Version
cards.body:
You are not falling behind, you are refueling.
Stand by the window for a while and refocus.
cards.footer: Let your heartbeat come back to normal speed first.
